external_solution_reused: go-trader composite clean/choppy regime split: ATR-normalized displacement and range, Kaufman efficiency, and Wilder ADX
hypothesis: V15 lower-Bollinger short gross profit should concentrate in clean downside price discovery, while choppy and non-directional states should contain a disproportionate failed-auction loss engine.

prediction_before_outcome.preserve: source Bollinger short entries classified trending_down_clean on the latest completed 30-minute state
prediction_before_outcome.remove: clean-up, choppy, ranging and unresolved short episodes before global arbitration
prediction_before_outcome.expected_effect: retain at least 55% of gross profit while removing at least 30% of gross loss and preserve at least 0.5 trade/day
prediction_before_outcome.falsification: clean-down episodes fail to improve cost-covering excursion and close follow-through, gross profit falls with gross loss, or replacement trades remain negative

episode_findings.clean_down_not_alpha_owner: Clean-down trades were negative in April, approximately flat in February, and a single losing trade in September.
episode_findings.false_negatives: Large source winners repeatedly occurred in trending_up_choppy, trending_down_choppy and ranging_volatile states; the clean gate removed them together with losses.
episode_findings.interpretation: The apparent NAV improvement came from deleting most trading, not from identifying the causal profit state. The lower-band short is not a clean-trend continuation family.

reason: The fixed market-state prediction failed before and after one-slot arbitration. Profit factor deteriorated, gross profit retention was only 11.35%, and opportunity density fell below the project minimum. Changing period or thresholds would be a parameter rescue without a valid state model.
next_model_update: Treat perpetual-versus-spot leadership, aggressor flow and OI state as the direct causal distinction. Development episode data shows premium collapse plus sell aggression is the only pooled positive natural quadrant; this is being tested on fresh accounts without fitted thresholds.
